plainLanguage: Waco is in McLennan County, Climate Zone 2A (hot-humid), so the energy design uses Zone 2 tables. We could not confirm Waco's code edition or zoning setbacks in this pass, so the engine uses typical values and asks you to confirm them from your plat. Waco sits on expansive Blackland clay, so plan for an engineer-designed slab. The city cannot require brick. Check flood maps near the Brazos and Bosque rivers.
